user.title: NTI net account
user.description: Sign in with the e-mail and password you use in the NTI net app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate NTI net
reauth_confirm.description: NTI net no longer accepts the stored password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the NTI net cloud.
error.rate_limited: NTI net is throttling this account. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.no_plants: This account has no appliances registered.

abort.reauth_successful: Your NTI net password was updated.
abort.reauth_failed: The account is no longer configured.

init.title: NTI net options
init.description: The cloud throttles per account, so the poll interval cannot go below 180 seconds.

set_zone_override.name: Set zone override
set_zone_override.description: Hold a zone at a fixed temperature until a given time, ignoring its schedule.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the gateway the zone belongs to.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone number as shown in the app.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the override expires. Defaults to the override already stored on the appliance.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.description: Gateway id, as an alternative to targeting an entity.

clear_zone_override.name: Clear zone override
clear_zone_override.description: Cancel a zone override and return the zone to its schedule.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the gateway the zone belongs to.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone number as shown in the app.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.description: Gateway id, as an alternative to targeting an entity.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday mode
set_holiday.description: Enable holiday mode until a given time, or clear it by omitting the time. Holiday state cannot be read back from the cloud.

until.name: Until
until.description: When holiday mode ends. Omit to clear it.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.description: Gateway id. Omit to apply to every gateway on the account.
